content: The United Homeless Organization (UHO) is a charitable organization based in New York City. It was established in 1987 with the mission of advocating for individuals experiencing homelessness. The organization raises funds by setting up donation tables at various locations throughout Manhattan. More than 75% of the individuals working for the UHO are currently homeless, and all of them have experienced homelessness at some point in their lives. According to a 2001 article, each worker at the donation tables is required to allocate $15 per shift to the organization itself, while the remaining funds collected during the shift are retained by the individual solicitor.
